messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@fintechco.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected June charges on INV-5241

Hi Neha,

We noticed a ~38% spike on our June invoice (INV-5241) vs. our April/May run rate — total due $21,842. The attached usage export shows the majority of the delta is tagged as 'burst' traffic on 2026-06-18 (we were not running any batch jobs then). Can you help explain the cause and whether Redwood can issue a credit for the erroneous usage?

We need the corrected invoice for our accounting close next week. If you need any details from our side I can pull any logs you want.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Finance Manager
FinTechCo
Attachment: usage-export-June2026.csv (CSV, 142KB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected June charges on INV-5241

Hi Emma — thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the surprise. We pulled the initial usage trace and it looks like a short-duration autoscaling burst from a scheduled CI task that accidentally ran against your key on 2026-06-18. That's on us.

Proposed remediation:
- We will issue a prorated credit for the excess usage (calculated as the delta above your May run rate) and a small goodwill credit for the operational impact.
- We can either apply the total credit to your next invoice or issue a one-time refund — which would you prefer?
- For EU VAT handling we need your VAT registration number to correctly apply/reverse VAT on the credit note.

Next steps from our side: Marcus (Finance) will draft the credit note and confirm amounts. I'll include a draft credit note for review once Marcus confirms. If you can reply with the invoice number you prefer credited (you referenced INV-5241 — correct?), and provide VAT ID if applicable, we'll move quickly.

Again, apologies — we'll take action as soon as we have your preference.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi Neha — thanks for the quick reply.

Confirming: please apply the credit to our next invoice rather than issuing a refund. Our VAT number is GB999888777. We do need the credit note to clearly show the VAT reversal line so our AP team can match it in SAP.

INV-5241 is the invoice to be credited. Expected timing would be ideal before our July 20 close. Can you confirm?

Thanks,
Emma

Hi Emma — copying Neha. Finance has calculated the adjustment after reviewing usage and run-rate baselines:

Summary (draft):
- Original invoice: INV-5241 — Gross $21,842.00 (VAT 20% included)
- Usage delta credit: $6,020.00 (net)
- Goodwill credit: $200.00 (net)
- Total credit (net): $6,220.00
- VAT reversal (20% on credited net): $1,244.00
- Total credit note amount (gross): $7,464.00

We will issue credit note CN-2026-078 referencing INV-5241 and reissue an adjusted invoice INV-5241-ADJ showing the negative line item and corrected VAT to make reconciliation straightforward for your AP. The credit will be applied to your next billing cycle as requested.

Timing: we can issue CN-2026-078 and the adjusted invoice by end of day Tuesday 2026-07-13; credit will reflect on your next invoice (expected generation 2026-07-18). I have attached the draft credit note for your records.

Attachment: draft-credit-note.pdf (PDF, 34KB)

Thanks,
